sloka: यो ह्यधर्ममकार्यं वा विषये पार्थिवस्य तु ।करोति चाश्रीमूलं तत्पुरे वा दुर्मतिर्नरः ।क्षिप्रं च नरकं याति स च राजा न संशयः ।। ७.७४.२९ ॥
transliteration: yo hyadharmamakāryaṁ vā viṣaye pārthivasya tu ।karoti cāśrīmūlaṁ tatpure vā durmatirnaraḥ ।kṣipraṁ ca narakaṁ yāti sa ca rājā na saṁśayaḥ ।। 7.74.29 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, any evil-minded person who commits unrighteousness or an improper act, which is the root of misfortune, in the king's kingdom or city, quickly goes to hell, and so does the king, without a doubt.
